before.logTail:
Poetry could not find a pyproject.toml file in /workspace or its parents
/firstrun/step-4.sh: line 5: /bin/activate: No such file or directory

diagnosis.cause: The `pyproject.toml` lives in `backend/app/` (confirmed by glob), but the sandbox working directory is the repo root when S8 runs; Poetry cannot locate the project, so `poetry env info --path` prints nothing and the activate script path is invalid — the `cd backend/app/` at README.md:96 must be part of the same shell command, not a separate prior step.

doc.text: Replace the two-line snippet at README.md lines 96-99 with a single combined command: `cd backend/app && source "$(poetry env info --path)/bin/activate"` so that Poetry can locate pyproject.toml and the environment activation works from any starting directory.

fix.log: step command → cd backend/app && source "$(poetry env info --path)/bin/activate"
